name: Aside
long_description:
Aside is an AI browser that completes real work across the websites you already use. It can sign in through your browser, work inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets, and keep going when a task takes minutes or hours.

Unlike agents that depend on integrations, Aside uses the web the way you do. Browsing history becomes local memory, so it knows which tools and context matter. Its password manager lets agents autofill credentials without exposing secrets to the AI. Sensitive actions like payments, posts, and messages wait for your approval.

We achieved state-of-the-art on agentic browsing benchmarks, surpassing OpenAI and Anthropic's result- Aside ranked #1 across Mind2Web, Odyssey, bu-bench-v1.
one_liner: The browser built to do real work for you

launches.title: Aside: Live answers for enterprise tech sales
launches.tagline: We help tech sales reps answer technical questions during calls.
launches.body:
**TL;DR** [Aside](https://asidehq.com/?utm_source=launch_yc) listens to your sales calls and surfaces answers from your docs, Slack, and past calls, helping tech sales reps answer technical questions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95050&key=user_uploads/1576589/8b08bb03-388b-48f9-a9c5-198a0329db44)

Hey 👋, we're Jun, Chanhee, and Sanghun, the founders of [Aside](https://asidehq.com/?utm_source=launch_yc).

Everyone’s using AI for sales these days - emails, outreach, everything - except the part that actually matters: the call.

## ❌ Problem: The Knowledge Gap in Sales

Sales reps often freeze when faced with technical questions. Like:

> Are HSTS or strict transport policies enforced during data transmission?

Most say, _“Let me get back to you”,_ and the deal cools off. That’s why teams burn $60K+ a year on coaching, mock calls, and LMS exams. I’ve paid that bill too.

But onboarding drags. Products change fast. Tech-savvy AEs are rare.

What if your reps could pull the right answers instantly– straight from your best calls, API docs, or Slack threads?

## ✨ Solution: Let your reps cheat on sales calls

[Aside](https://asidehq.com/?utm_source=launch_yc) listens to your sales calls and surfaces real-time answers pulled from your docs, HubSpot, or past calls. It's like pressing **𝚌𝚝𝚛𝚕+𝚟** on your company’s knowledge into every rep – so anyone can sound like your best rep.

**_🎬 Watch our [launch video](https://youtu.be/ZZVn6w0o8jQ) 👇_**

---

---

# How it works

\*\*🔎 Get answers from your docs, Slack, and past winning calls.\*\*\
When a tough question hits, just click **“How can I answer?”** - the right answer lands in 800ms. No guessing, no “let me get back to you”.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95050&key=user_uploads/1576589/873df5e6-aeb0-4bc6-bc89-ff00031ecf4c)

📝 **Live coaching that catches what you miss**\
When you miss a key pain point, Aside flags it live — before the deal goes cold. It nudges what to ask next and coaches you using your playbook — BANT, SPICED, whatever your team runs on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95050&key=user_uploads/1576589/667d0f76-a05a-46ff-9d2f-4fa8a781f218)

💬 **Preload your cheatsheets as Live Cards**\
Turn your best answers into in-call cards that pop up right when you need them. No more flipping tabs — your best answers, ready the moment the question hits.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95050&key=user_uploads/1576589/d9b7fd18-89bb-418d-a733-85713ab3f4a1)

**🎓 Coaching feedback, remembered by AI**\
After the call, Aside reviews what happened, gives you feedback, and turns it into live suggestions for the next one - so you never repeat the same mistake.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95050&key=user_uploads/1576589/efb28b23-26ec-49b4-a50e-a66616439ca6)

# Our story

Jun and Chanhee were the founding engineers of [Airbridge.io](http://Airbridge.io). Jun worked with 50+ reps as a solutions consultant - the person who answers technical questions on calls. So basically, we're replacing our past selves with AI!

# Ask

* Try it: [AsideHQ.com](https://asidehq.com)
* Know any B2B tech startups that are actively hiring new reps? Intro us!
* Been using sales coaching tools? Reach out to us! (_we have a special offer for you_)
